page_title: EVE 1-4 NEW | Everton v Newcastle 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Unlucky! A great strike from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
90+5' Dwight McNeil (Everton) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
90+3' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A substitution has been made. Nick Woltemade goes off and Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
90' It is time for a substitution. Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is on for Lewis Hall.
90' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
87' Substitution. Beto (Everton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Thierno Barry walks off.
85' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
84' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
80' Substitution. Dwight McNeil (Everton) on for Jack Grealish.
80' Here is a change. Iliman Ndiaye is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Tyler Dibling (Everton).

80' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Jordan Pickford was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
77' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Joelinton (Newcastle Utd). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
74' Jordan Pickford leaps to intercept the corner kick from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
73' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Craig Pawson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
72' Thierno Barry (Everton) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
71' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Harvey Barnes is replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd).
71' The game has come to an end for Anthony Elanga. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
69' 1 - 4 Goal! James Tarkowski sends a precise cross into the box, Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:4.
67' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Everton due to a handball in the build-up play.
66' Wait! Referee Craig Pawson has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
64' Thierno Barry (Everton) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball inside the left post. What a wonderful strike!
62' Jack Grealish (Everton) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
61' The corner from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is cleared away by the defence.
58' 0 - 4 Goal! Lewis Hall swings the ball deep into the box and finds Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the left side of the goal. 0:4.
57' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

57' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Jordan Pickford is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. Newcastle earn a corner.
56' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
54' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!
53' James Garner (Everton) swings in a cross from the corner, but Aaron Ramsdale reads it well and gathers the ball.
53' Thierno Barry (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Everton have a corner.
50' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' James Garner (Everton) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. David Moyes probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Tim Iroegbunam. He is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
46' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' James Garner (Everton) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 3 Goal! Anthony Elanga gets to the ball, slips Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 0:3.
44' A raking crossfield pass from Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. It's a throw-in for Everton.
42' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' The Newcastle players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
37' Everton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
34' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
32' Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
29' The resulting corner from Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) comes to nothing.

29' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.

25' 0 - 2 Goal! Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Jordan Pickford is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:2.
24' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
22' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
21' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
19' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

17' A pass lands at the feet of Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jack Grealish (Everton).
15' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd). Everton earn a free kick.

13' James Garner (Everton) can't believe his eyes as he blows an opportunity from close range. It looked really simple and he only needed to tap the ball in, but he failed. The ball goes well wide of the right post. Hang your head in shame son. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.

11' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
11' Everton get a corner.
11' Michael Keane (Everton) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Everton win a corner.
10' Everton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
10' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
9' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Jordan Pickford has no trouble gathering it.

9' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
8' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
7' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
6' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
1' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.

1' Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Jordan Pickford pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Everton will kick the game off.
Craig Pawson is the one to supervise the game today.
